// HOOKS: Unified hook configuration for Claude Code 2.1+
// DOCS: See hooks/README.md. Matchers are tool names (Bash, Edit|Write); scope to inputs inside the command or with a handler-level `if`. There is no `message` handler type — a command hook emits a reminder via JSON {"systemMessage": ...} on exit 0, or blocks the call with exit 2.

PreToolUse.// PURPOSE: Warn before git push — review changes first

hooks.command: printf '%s' '{"systemMessage":"REMINDER: Review git diff and run tests before pushing. Are you on the staging branch?"}'

PreToolUse.// PURPOSE: Block creating markdown files outside standard directories

hooks.command: FILE=$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path'); case "$FILE" in */README.md|*/CHANGELOG.md|*/CONTRIBUTING.md|README.md|CHANGELOG.md|CONTRIBUTING.md|*/docs/*|*/agents/*|*/rules/*|*/skills/*) exit 0;; *.md) echo 'Put docs in docs/, agents/, rules/, or skills/.' >&2; exit 2;; *) exit 0;; esac

PreToolUse.// PURPOSE: Remind about tmux for long-running dev servers

hooks.command: CMD=$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.command'); printf '%s' "$CMD" | grep -qE '(npm run dev|npm start|python.*runserver|go run|cargo run)' && printf '%s' '{"systemMessage":"REMINDER: Run long-running dev servers in tmux or a separate terminal for log access."}'; exit 0

PostToolUse.// PURPOSE: Format JS/TS with Prettier after edit

hooks.command: FILE=$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path'); case "$FILE" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.jsx) npx prettier --write "$FILE" 2>/dev/null || true;; esac
FILE=$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path'); case "$FILE" in *.ts|*.tsx) npx tsc --noEmit --pretty 2>&1 | head -20 || true;; esac

PostToolUse.// PURPOSE: Lint and format Python with ruff after edit

hooks.command: FILE=$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path'); case "$FILE" in *.py) ruff check --fix "$FILE" 2>/dev/null && ruff format "$FILE" 2>/dev/null || true;; esac

PostToolUse.// PURPOSE: Format Go with gofmt after edit

hooks.command: FILE=$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path'); case "$FILE" in *.go) gofmt -w "$FILE" 2>/dev/null || true;; esac

Stop.// PURPOSE: Warn about console.log in modified files

hooks.command: git diff --name-only --diff-filter=M 2>/dev/null | xargs grep -l 'console\.log' 2>/dev/null && echo 'WARNING: console.log found in modified files' || true
